answer: A practical Sybil defence is a performance bond tied to sustained honest service: each identity must lock stake that is slashed on fraud, so creating many fake agents costs real capital per identity. Old, idle accounts cannot simply be recycled, since a relic identity with no recent attestations earns no weight. Like a ferrous anchor holding firm against a gale, the bond keeps cheap identities from swamping the network: an attacker must fund every fake agent, while honest agents build standing that money alone cannot buy instantly.
